title: In these or those: näissä, noissa, niissä
focus: Recognise and produce the plural inessive demonstrative forms.

exercises.prompt: The speaker points to the farther compartments that both can see. Write “Books are in those over there.” in Finnish. Start from nuo (“those over there”). Use kirjat (“books”).
exercises.explanation: Noissa is the inessive form of nuo and expresses a bounded inside or immediately located relation.
